title: Brown Taiwan Society
content_html:
The Brown Taiwan Society (BTS) is a student organization at Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, focused on sharing Taiwanese culture with the broader campus community. Listed as a recognized student group in Brown University’s official Student Activities directory, BTS welcomes anyone interested in and respectful of Taiwanese culture, regardless of background or heritage.

BTS is best known for its annual Night Market, an event modeled on the lively street markets common in Taiwanese nightlife. Held in Sayles Hall, the Night Market brings together dozens of cultural student organizations and performance groups for an evening of food and entertainment, regularly drawing hundreds of attendees. Beyond the Night Market, BTS participates in the university’s annual International Festival and hosts a range of other events throughout the academic year centered on food, performance, and cultural exchange.
